writtenBefore: any line of the implementation, and before the first run
whatItIs: One row per obligation across a boundary: what was detected, what is disputed, what is independently evidenced as collected, what is still open, where the evidence came from, and the gate's verdict. It is the CFO-facing view of the financial trace and computes no new money.

columns.means: the governed root this row is about
SINGLE_OBLIGATION, ACCOUNT_AGGREGATE or NOT_STATED, as the detector recorded it
columns.whyItLeads: a figure whose subject is an aggregate is not a per-obligation figure, and the column saying so must come before any amount

columns.means: OBSERVED_EXPOSURE, read from the frozen promotion row
the magnitude that is unreported or overstated BECAUSE precedence is undecided
columns.nullMeans: the observation order is not establishable, so the magnitude is unknowable

columns.means: the correction ledger's own state, or NOT_OBSERVED
what NH CLAIMS is independently evidenced as collected
what the frozen proof chain computed, carried FOR AUDIT ONLY and never as collected

columns.nullMeans: exposure is not established, so no balance can be stated

columns.means: per evidence row: source system, trust classification, and whether a source signature verified
the financial trace's attestation verdict for this case
ELIGIBLE, or the obligation-identity gate's own refusal code
every reason Revenue Returned is withheld for this row

properties.property: claimedIndependentlyEvidencedCollectedMinor is 0 on every row, and that zero is an ASSERTION rather than an absence
properties.expectedBehaviour: the value is 0 and a sibling field states it is asserted; it is never null, and a reader can tell this apart from a figure that was not computed
properties.rule: 'we claim nothing' and 'nobody computed it' are different statements, and the CFO column that matters most must not conflate them

properties.property: openBalanceMinor equals detectedExposureMinor on this build
properties.expectedBehaviour: because the claimed collected figure is 0, every detected dollar is still open; null exposure yields null balance, never 0

properties.property: the disputed amount is NEVER subtracted from exposure, and never added to it
properties.rule: netting a disputed magnitude into exposure would be the S-DUP-4 precedence decision wearing a different name

properties.property: no row and no total presents a positive collected or returned figure as money the business got back
properties.expectedBehaviour: a source scan finds no field named corrected/authoritative/effective/resolved, and the report asserts no collected amount above zero

properties.property: totals exist only for additive columns, and there is no grand total across columns
properties.expectedBehaviour: per-column totals for exposure, disputed and open balance; SOURCE-stated statements are not summed; no field holds a cross-column sum
a digest over a canonical form that excludes clock values; two runs over the same records agree
operator 403, author 403, unauthenticated 401, approver 200, another tenant's approver refused

properties.property: an empty boundary yields a report with zero rows, and that is NOT a finding that nothing is owed
properties.expectedBehaviour: rows empty, every total null rather than 0, and an explicit statement that no case was found rather than that no money is outstanding
